name: What should I do to prepare my home before a repair technician arrives?

mainEntity.name: What should I do to prepare my home before a repair technician arrives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before our crew arrives, clear the immediate work area by moving furniture, fragile decor, rugs, and personal items at least three to four feet away from the repair spot. If the repair involves matching wall paint or stain, have leftover paint cans, color codes, or spare matching tiles readily available. Providing clear driveway access and identifying nearby electrical outlets also helps our team set up tools quickly and maintain a clean workspace.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear furniture away from the work zone, secure pets, and set out any leftover matching paint, spare tiles, or trim boards you have on hand.
